summary: P2 (standards; probed on mutated publish.yml): _whoami_calls still passes unguarded calls that I13 says count whatever the form: `npm whoami>/dev/null` and `npm whoami</dev/null` (`<`/`>` are not word breaks, so the word is `whoami>/dev/null`), `X=${Y:-$(npm whoami)}` unquoted (the `${` branch jumps to the first `}` and skips the substitution), and any call after a heredoc whose body has an apostrophe (`can't`, read as an open single quote). Fix: end the word on `<` and `>` in code mode, scan `${...}` with nesting and its `$(`/backticks, and skip heredoc bodies. Blast radius: the shipped pre-flight passes; only a future edit of the pre-flight is exposed.
